messages.subject: Warning: Error in setnames: Can't assign 4 names to a 0 column data.table
parts:
Hi, 

I am trying to use a DIA skyline format with Shiny to run my data through MS Stats however I keep running into this error:

File type is sky
Reached here in skyline
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:28] ** Raw data from Skyline imported successfully.
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:29] ** Raw data from Skyline cleaned successfully.
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:29] ** Using provided annotation.
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:29] ** Run and Channel labels were standardized to remove symbols such as '.' or '%'.
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:29] ** The following options are used:
  - Features will be defined by the columns: IsotopeLabelType, PeptideSequence, PrecursorCharge, FragmentIon, ProductCharge
  - Shared peptides will be removed.
  - Proteins with a single feature will be removed.
  - Features with less than 3 measurements across runs will be removed.
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:29] ** Rows with values of StandardType equal to iRT are removed
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:29] ** Intensities with values of Truncated equal to TRUE are replaced with NA
WARN  [2022-07-25 11:24:29] ** DetectionQValue not found in input columns.
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:29] ** Sequences containing DECOY, Decoys are removed.
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:31] ** Features with all missing measurements across runs are removed.
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:31] ** Shared peptides are removed.
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:31] ** Multiple measurements in a feature and a run are summarized by summaryforMultipleRows: sum
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:31] ** Features with one or two measurements across runs are removed.
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:31] Proteins with a single feature are removed.
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:31] ** Run annotation merged with quantification data.
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:31] ** Features with one or two measurements across channels within each run are removed.
INFO  [2022-07-25 11:24:31] ** Fractionation handled.
Warning: Error in setnames: Can't assign 4 names to a 0 column data.table

I've attached a smaller dataset and annotation file and was wondering if you could look if there was anything obvious?

Thanks!
Jonathan

thanks for providing the data, however, to reproduce the error, I need a complete annotation table (labels don't matter, but the structure does), could you kindly provide it? Again, it may be anonymized


Kind regards,
Mateusz
